decisions.reason: A GA4 tracking plugin builds directly on the firm's web analytics and implementation know-how, and in 2024 the successor standard still offers enough learning and client demand to justify keeping it.
A Google Universal Analytics plugin has become commercially obsolete after the market shift to GA4, so the firm's existing knowledge is better redeployed to current analytics products.

A retail system interface plugin fits the firm's programming and integration capabilities and can be improved through accumulated client-specific knowledge, even if demand may be narrower than for general web tools.

A shop relaunch SEO support service is strongly related to the firm's consultancy base and website-facing expertise, and its prominent presentation suggests it is strategically relevant and adaptable through ongoing learning.
